name: Nigeria
summary: West African powerhouse experiencing rapid demographic and urban growth in coastal and inland basins. Facing elevated particulate burdens from biomass cooking fuels, generator exhaust, and Saharan Harmattan dust.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 10.48x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); winter Harmattan dust storms combine with heavy generator exhaust in Lagos and Kano.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; humid heat stress increasing in Niger Delta and southern coastal belt.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across West African savanna stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.4% share of global fossil emissions; gas flaring reduction initiatives advancing in Niger Delta.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: One of the lowest per capita emission footprints globally; reflects deep off-grid biomass energy reliance.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Tropical rainforests and savanna woodlands ~217,000 km²; experiencing severe firewood harvesting pressures.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Generation almost exclusively from Kainji and Jebba hydropower dams on the Niger River.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 246 people/km²; urban population fraction is 53.5%.
